how_scores_work: Each version gets up to 100 points: evidence that people have this problem (30 points), fit with your skills, budget and time (25 points), places to reach these customers (20 points), can be built as a first version (15 points), room next to existing options (10 points). These weights are design choices, not facts (config/scoring.toml).

points.Evidence that people have this problem: 17 of 30: Found 3 real examples of people describing this problem or looking for help with it, on linkedin.com, pinterest.com and supercareer.co. problem_claims: Design pricing issues are among the most common pain points discussed in creative communities across Reddit, and they’re costing designers thousands of dollars in lost revenue every year.
Designers look for guidance on how to negotiate higher rates.
Freelance designers often fear saying no and feel pressured to undersell themselves when clients ask about rates.
Freelancers actively seek guidance on how to increase rates and negotiate pricing, as shown by articles offering strategies and example emails.
Freelance designers often have clients who owe them large amounts of money and they struggle to keep track of these debts.
There is a demand for guides that help freelancers track unpaid invoices using spreadsheets.
Freelance designers often have clients who do not pay on time, leaving them with unpaid invoices.
Freelance designers struggle to estimate how many hours a project will take.
Freelance designers look for tools or guides to calculate their rates and project costs quickly.
